skill.name: Homeward Wind
skill.text: For 3 rounds after using a skill, Odysseus restores HP to allies at the end of each enemy action equal to 50% of the damage that action dealt.

skill.name: Eternal Sovereignty
skill.text: When Caesar casts a skill and that causes a second extra ATK to trigger, allies gain skill damage bonus +10% and extra damage bonus +50% for 3 rounds.

skill.name: Twin Revolver Pursuit
skill.text: After Billy the Kid deals damage with a skill, there is a 30% chance to trigger [Deathblow] on 1 enemy. Executed targets cannot be revived.

skill.name: Express Kick
skill.text: After Hermes uses his skill, the dodge chance of [Sprint] rises by 30%.

skill.name: Achilles
skill.text: Before using a skill, Achilles raises allies’ CRIT DMG by 50% for 3 rounds.

skill.name: The Resistance
skill.text: Before Spartacus casts a skill, allies gain +15% skill damage bonus. For each debuff on the enemy, allies gain an extra +15% skill damage bonus this round. Stacks up to 2 times.

skill.name: The Screaming Eagle
skill.text: After Pompey casts a skill, if his HP is above 50%, allies gain +20% skill damage bonus for 3 rounds. If his HP is 50% or below, allies restore HP equal to 10% of their max HP.

skill.name: Strength of Heracles
skill.text: When Heracles uses a skill, 1 debuff is removed from allies. If allies have at most as many debuffs as the enemies, 1 extra instance of damage equal to 100% of ATK is dealt.

skill.name: The Inner Beast
skill.text: After Circe uses a skill, the healing effect of enemies with [Death Curse] is reduced by 10% for 1 round before their action.

skill.name: Realm-Toppling Splendor
skill.text: After Cleopatra uses this skill, the enemy’s next action is replaced by an allied attack that uses a random enemy skill against that enemy and deals 80% of that skill’s original damage.

skill.name: La Gioconda
skill.text: After Da Vinci uses a skill, allies gain 20% skill damage reduction for 3 rounds.

skill.name: Gleaming Coin
skill.text: If Augustus casts a skill within the first 5 rounds, allies’ skill coefficient this round rises by 50%.

skill.name: Shakespeare
skill.text: After Shakespeare casts his skill, if allies’ ATK is higher than the enemies’, there is a 20% chance to trigger 1 extra [Destruction]. If allies’ ATK is lower than or equal to the enemies’, there is a 20% chance to trigger 1 extra [Survive].

skill.name: Pharaoh’s Trial
skill.text: When using a skill, Tutankhamun has a 50% chance to remove 2 buffs from enemies who have at least 2 active buffs.

skill.name: Bucephalus’ Pursuit
skill.text: After Alexander the Great triggers [Pursuit] (an extra spell cast), 1 extra skill cast is triggered. There is a 50% chance to trigger [Pursuit] again and deal extra damage equal to 100% of ATK.

skill.name: Star Guidance
skill.text: When Isaac Newton uses a skill, the chance to grant all allies a bonus to ATK and CRIT DMG rises by 50%.

skill.name: The Queen’s Crown
skill.text: After Queen Victoria casts a skill, she grants all allies [Reflection] for 3 rounds (when the bearer is hit by a skill, they reflect 20% of the skill damage taken, up to 100% of the caster’s ATK).

skill.name: Burn, Empire!
skill.text: When Napoleon Bonaparte uses a skill and triggers [Pursuit] (an extra spell cast), he deals 1 extra attack with 100% extra damage.

skill.name: Blessing of the First Flame
skill.text: Increases allies’ ATK bonus by 22.5% and skill damage bonus by 22.5%. Lasts the whole battle.

skill.name: Resistance of the Underworld
skill.text: At the start of battle, absorbs 41% of the enemies’ total ATK for 5 rounds (max. 100% of own total ATK).

skill.name: Stone-Born Rebirth
skill.text: After allies act, every 2 rounds: allies with 2 or more buffs restore 15% of their max HP.

skill.name: Victory of the Pioneers
skill.text: Every 4 rounds, the frontmost ally who has not cast a skill yet casts one (ignores control effects; if no skill is available, performs a basic attack) and gains a 250% skill damage bonus.

skill.name: Aegis Wheel
skill.text: Grants a shield equal to 25% of max HP when an ally’s HP first drops below 50%. Skill damage reduction rises by 17.5% while the shield holds and by 17.5% after it breaks.

skill.name: Oath of the Thunder Warden
skill.text: Caps damage taken at 13.5% of max HP for 3 rounds when HP first drops below 35%.

skill.name: Born to Die
skill.text: 100% chance, the first time HP drops to 0, to revive 9–11 fallen allies with their skills refilled.

skill.name: Vengeance Blade
skill.text: After enemies act, they take extra collection damage equal to 108% of this round’s total DoT damage.

skill.name: Martyr
skill.text: Increases allies’ CRIT DMG by 64%. Each fallen ally additionally raises all allies’ skill damage bonus by 4.8%. Lasts the whole battle.

skill.name: Divine Seal
skill.text: After allies act, every 2 rounds: if enemies have at least 2 debuffs, 65% chance to trigger [Seal] (unable to act for 1 round).

skill.name: Bell Judgement
skill.text: After allies cast a skill or trigger [Pursuit] (an extra spell cast), 55% chance to deal one instance of damage equal to 150% of ATK.

skill.name: Divine Gift of Life
skill.text: Allies gain a shield equal to 80% of the healing effect when they are healed.

skill.name: Wheel of Misfortune
skill.text: Each ally action has a 50% chance to empower the attack and raise all allies’ skill damage bonus by 80%.

skill.name: Sunbeam
skill.text: Gains +9.6% ATK after allies act, up to 5 stacks. Lasts the whole battle.

skill.name: Divine Protection
skill.text: Skill damage reduction +9.6% after allies act, up to 5 stacks. Lasts the whole battle.

skill.name: Glimmer of Hope
skill.text: Heals 32% of max HP when HP first drops below 50%.

skill.name: Citywide Seal
skill.text: 58% chance to [Seal] an enemy for 1 round (unable to act) after every 3 skills it uses.

skill.name: Glacier Barrier
skill.text: Every 3 rounds, reduces the enemy’s skill damage reduction by 80% for 1 round.

skill.name: Thrower’s Curse
skill.text: When a debuff is applied to an enemy, 78% chance to extend its duration by 2 rounds.

skill.name: Germ Corrosion
skill.text: When battle begins, increases allies’ ATK bonus by 16% and CRIT DMG by 48%. Lasts the whole battle.

skill.name: Blessing of the Holy Light
skill.text: After allies cast a skill or trigger [Pursuit] (an extra spell cast), reduces enemies’ skill damage reduction by 8% for 3 rounds.

skill.name: Book of Healing
skill.text: Increases allies’ healing effect by 58%. Lasts until the end of battle.

skill.name: Hellish Torment
skill.text: Increases DoT damage dealt by allies by 70%. Lasts the whole battle.

skill.name: Blessing of Starlight
skill.text: When allies receive a buff, 75% chance to extend its duration by 2 rounds.
